gaps.explanation: The report prints two different nonmajor transfers-in figures. p4 Statement of Cash Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, row 'Transfers in': Road Fund 2,591,391 + Equipment Sinking Fund 17,811 + Nonmajor Funds 182,443 = Total 2,791,645. Detail: General Fund 'Transfers In' 0 (p6) + Road Fund 2,591,391 (p7) + Equipment Sinking Fund 17,811 (p8) + 'Nonmajor funds (combined)' 182,422 (p13 combining statement, Total Nonmajor Funds column, printed 182,422) = 2,791,624. Gap 21 = p4 182,443 - p13 182,422. The p13 combining statement also prints 178,151 / 874,971 where p4 prints 178,152 / 874,972, and its individual fund columns print Special Road 175,916 + Federal Drug Law Enforcement 2,235 + Federal Equitable Sharing 4,291 = 182,442 (a third figure). The nonmajor detail is taken from the p13 Total Nonmajor Funds column, so neither the p4 Nonmajor Funds cell nor the p13 per-fund cells can be added without counting the same money twice; no printed line is missing and none is duplicated. Checked every other p4 fund-column other-financing row: Transfers out General (2,611,437) p6, Inheritance (175,917) p7, Nonmajor (4,291) p13 are all in detail; the report prints no bond/loan proceeds or other other-financing rows. The 21 is a difference inside the printed report (p4 vs p13).
